author: opencode-worker-5
text: Scope survey (worker-5, 2026-09-01): the C runtime has NO DAO send site (dodag.c has no DAO TX; the dao_timing.c oracle is only exercised by tests/rpl_dao_timing). Wiring requires (1) a composed TX timing orchestrator over the three existing timers, (2) new DAO send site in the runtime loop, (3) host tests. Decomposing: (a) orchestrator + host test (independently landable, mirrors my Rust dao_tx_timing.rs design); (b) runtime-loop wiring (follow-up). Claiming (a) this round.
